story_type: stranded test crew finally splashes down, parachute and onboard views
hook: They went up on a test flight. They came home 286 days later.
narration: Two astronauts went up on a test flight. Two hundred eighty six days later, this was their ride home.
Butch Wilmore and Suni Williams had arrived at the space station as the test crew for Boeing's Starliner.
They were folded into the station crew instead, and Williams commanded the station for much of the expedition.
On March eighteenth, they rode home in a SpaceX Dragon named Freedom, with Nick Hague and cosmonaut Aleksandr Gorbunov.
Dragon opens its own parachutes when its sensors detect the right speed and altitude. First come two small drogues.
Then four mains slowed them to about sixteen miles an hour at the water. Minutes earlier, they had been moving at over seventeen thousand.
[short pause] The capsule touched down on a calm sea off Tallahassee, Florida, and its main chutes were cut away.
Fast boats moved in to check the capsule and pull its parachutes out of the water.
outcome: Wilmore and Williams were back on Earth after two hundred eighty six days in space.
title: Stuck in space 286 days, then splashdown
description:
On March 18, 2025, NASA astronauts Butch Wilmore and Suni Williams splashed down off Florida in a SpaceX Dragon with Nick Hague and cosmonaut Aleksandr Gorbunov, after 286 days in space. They had arrived at the station as the crew of Starliner's first crewed test flight.
